answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof of computational stake prevents Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to verifiable resource expenditure. Instead of relying on a fragile moral fable, the network forces every node to lock economic value into a secure smart contract resembling a digital crystal lattice. If an attacker attempts to spawn millions of fake agents, the cumulative hardware and energy costs scale linearly, making the exploit economically unviable and protecting the collective digital grove.
